name: plugin.icm_architect
description: Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM, arXiv:2603.16021) workspace architecture, contract auditing, link verification, quote verification, and index generation
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: icm_audit_workspace
entrypoints.description: Audit an ICM workspace against the 10 mandatory invariants, classify files into 5 roles, and estimate per-step token loads

entrypoints.name: icm_verify_links
entrypoints.description: Verify that all relative markdown links, contract inputs, and pointer lines resolve cleanly without breaking

parameters.name: skip_folders
parameters.description: Optional list of folder names to skip

parameters.name: graph_file
parameters.description: Optional output path to write JSONL node/edge graph file

entrypoints.name: icm_verify_quotes
entrypoints.description: Verify that quoted text appears verbatim in raw sources and enforce keep-out phrase defenses

parameters.name: show_cuts
parameters.description: Whether to list text dropped by cuts

entrypoints.name: icm_rebuild_index
entrypoints.description: Rebuild _index.md files across shelves and record folders from frontmatter metadata

parameters.name: folders
parameters.description: List of folder paths to re-index

entrypoints.name: icm_scaffold_form
entrypoints.description: Scaffold a new production-ready ICM workspace from one of the 5 canonical forms

parameters.name: target_dir
parameters.description: Directory path to scaffold the workspace in

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: ICM form: pipeline, record_library, knowledge_bundle, context_map, or system_map

entrypoints.name: icm_scaffold_workspace
entrypoints.description: Scaffold a full production workspace from canonical templates (arXiv:2603.16021)

parameters.name: target_dir
parameters.description: Directory path to scaffold the workspace in

parameters.name: template_name
parameters.description: Canonical template: workspace-builder, script-to-animation, voice-driven-animation, course-deck-production

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Dictionary of variables to interpolate into markdown templates

entrypoints.name: icm_interpolate_template
entrypoints.description: Substitute {{VARIABLE}} tags and resolve conditionals per _core/placeholder-syntax.md

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Dictionary of variable replacements and conditional toggles

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Optional path to write output file (defaults to overwriting template_path)
